name: aspire
description: Ships with the Aspire CLI: reaches a running AppHost to list resources, read its console/structured logs and distributed traces, start and stop resources, and search the Aspire documentation. Declared by the aspire stack because it is the CLI's own agent surface, not a separate install.

prerequisite.summary: the Aspire CLI — the server is `aspire agent mcp`, a subcommand of it, so there is nothing separate to install and nothing to install it with
